mapper.select: SELECT fr.*, u.username as user_username, v.vehicle_code as vehicle_code, op.username as operator_username FROM fault_reports fr LEFT JOIN users u ON fr.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN vehicles v ON fr.vehicle_id = v.id LEFT JOIN users op ON fr.operator_id = op.id ORDER BY fr.create_time DESC
